notes.title: Kraino Origins Localization + Art improvement + Bug fixes
notes.notes: Kraino Origins has now been localized in Spanish, French, German, & Brazilian Portuguese! Also Some levels and UI have had their art redone to look better. And some bug fixes and gameplay improvements are also in.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some enemies not freezing when hit with ice axe
Minor enemy balancing

notes.title: Minor Balance Update
notes.notes:
Adjusted sub weapon prices (lower)
Added missing spider sound effect
Enemy Damage balancing
Fixed platforms with incorrect collision placement
